description: The shared policy, plus dashboard approval for every GitHub Actions update, for repos whose CI checks Renovate's PRs. Use with {"extends": ["github>matbind/renovate-config:actions-approval"]}.

packageRules.description: An Actions update changes the workflow that checks its own PR, so a green check does not vouch for it: it opens only after approval in the dashboard and is never merged automatically.
A branch waits for approval when any update in it does, so Actions minor and patch updates get their own weekly group instead of holding back the shared one.
packageRules.groupName: GitHub Actions minor and patch updates
